# KIM DESIGN STUDIO

> Award-winning architecture and interior design studio crafting timeless spaces in Myanmar and beyond.

KIM DESIGN STUDIO designs residential, commercial, and hospitality spaces with a minimalist luxury approach. The site showcases completed work, services, and the studio's story, and lets prospective clients begin a conversation.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Studio introduction, featured work, and services overview.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Curated archive of completed projects with filters by category and year.
- [Projects](/projects): Public project archive with detailed galleries.
- [Services](/services): Architecture, interior design, and consulting offerings.
- [About](/about): Studio philosophy, team, and history.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on design, projects, and process.
- [Contact](/contact): Inquire about new projects.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of public pages.
